import hmac
import hashlib

def validate_reset_token(user_id, token, secret_key):
    expected = hmac.new(
        secret_key.encode(),
        user_id.encode(),
        hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()
    
    if hmac.compare_digest(token, expected):
        return True
    
    return False
